objective: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke

description: Oh my!  If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.
You better bring the translated note back to Ello.
And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
progress: Ah, is the note translated? Please, let me see it...
completion: <Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white. He then looks at you...>
Although the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town.
